name: Tropical Daze: The Music of Summer
source: Join Jason as he schemes to add even more girls to his harem. His aunt and three lovely cousins run a tropical resort far away from his home. Pack your bags and bring your brainwashing device - it's time for a vacation!
translation: 与杰森一起计划将更多女孩加入他的后宫。他的姨妈和三个可爱的表兄弟在离他家很远的地方经营着一个热带度假村。收拾好行囊，带上洗脑器——放假的时间到了！
